Mara searched the horizon with her telescope, though only fog and waves answered. She wrote back, telling Eli that fear was no shame, and that a steady light could guide anyone toward shore. Its sailor raised one hand toward the lighthouse, and Mara raised hers in return.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市像一艘暂时停泊的巨船，沉在蓝灰色的雾里。高楼窗口零星亮着灯，仿佛有人把星星遗落在人间。街道空旷，只有清洁车缓缓驶过，水珠映出路灯的微光。早点铺升起第一缕热气，面包香混进清冷的风。远处传来几声鸟鸣，地铁还未苏醒，钟表却不停向前。有人刚刚结束夜班，有人即将迎来新的一天。此刻的城市安静而柔软，藏着疲惫，也藏着希望。","w03":"- Recursion is when a set of instructions solves a problem by asking a smaller version of itself to help.\n- It needs a stopping rule, like reaching the smallest piece, so it doesn’t keep going forever.\n- For example, to count a pile of blocks, count one block and then use the same idea for the smaller pile."}
